experiment.name: ablation
experiment.hypothesis: The bounded evidence-driven retry is the ingredient that carries advanced mode. Removing it lowers the verified repair rate on hard faults.
experiment.rule: Call the bounded retry load-bearing only if the 95 percent interval on control minus treatment excludes zero, over the same cases, repeats, model and budget. An interval that includes zero is reported as unresolved, never as evidence that the retry does not help.

decision.reason: removing it cost +34.3 points (95% CI +16.1 to +51.0), an interval that excludes zero, so it is load-bearing
